title: A few useful controls

## Buttons and links

<div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-4">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="this.textContent='Selected'">Primary</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="this.textContent='Selected'">Secondary</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" onclick="this.textContent='Selected'">Outline</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" disabled>Disabled</button>
</div>

## Forms

<div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label" for="example-title">Notebook title</label><input class="form-control" id="example-title" value="Ideas worth keeping"></div>
<div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label" for="example-kind">Collection</label><select class="form-select" id="example-kind"><option>Reading notes</option><option>Code examples</option><option>Working ideas</option></select></div>
<div class="form-check mb-4"><input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="example-check" checked><label class="form-check-label" for="example-check">Keep this note close</label></div>

## Messages

<div class="alert alert-success" role="status">The note has been saved.</div>
<div class="alert alert-warning" role="note">A title makes this easier to find.</div>

::: {.callout-note}
## A SmallDocs note
The theme's callouts sit alongside the ordinary Bootstrap controls.
:::
